expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Full component with DocumentsResponse type, BulkSelection union type, getDocuments(), runBulkAction() functions, pagination, and table

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Implemented handlers: toggleDocument(), togglePage(), selectAllMatching(), performBulkAction(), IndeterminateCheckbox component, full state management

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Delete action only uses window.confirm: "if (action === 'delete' && !window.confirm(`Permanently delete...`))" with no soft-delete or trash mechanism

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: "{selectedCount.toLocaleString()} document{selectedCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected" displayed in bulk action bar above buttons

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Separate UI blocks for each mode: "All {selectedCount} documents on this selection are selected" vs "All {selectedCount.toLocaleString()} matching documents are selected"

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive button uses 'bg-white...text-slate-800' (outlined/secondary), Delete uses 'bg-red-600...text-white' (filled/warning red)

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive button appears first in button sequence; Delete follows with red styling indicating warning rather than primary action

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Comments describe API structure and filter passing but contain no explicit note that server must enforce authorization or selection rules

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Code ends with pagination footer; no prose or documentation addressing what attacks/misuses the design prevents
